description: 在輕鬆聊天時，能用英文介紹自己的興趣與嗜好，例如閱讀、旅行、園藝、攝影等。

sentences.en: Hi, what do you like to do in your free time?
sentences.zh: 嗨，你平常有空的時候喜歡做什麼？
sentences.tips: 問對方興趣說 What do you like to do in your free time?，比 What's your hobby? 更自然口語。

sentences.en: I love gardening. It's very relaxing for me.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡園藝。這讓我非常放鬆。
sentences.tips: 表達喜好可用 I enjoy、I love、I like，後面接動名詞（-ing）或名詞，三者語意相近，enjoy 語氣最強烈。

sentences.en: That's nice. I enjoy reading and taking a walk in the park.
sentences.zh: 那很好。我喜歡看書和在公園散步。
sentences.tips: 表達喜好可用 I enjoy、I love、I like，後面接動名詞（-ing）或名詞，三者語意相近，enjoy 語氣最強烈。

sentences.en: Do you read books in English?
sentences.tips: 聊興趣時，多問 And you? 或 What about you? 讓對方也有機會分享，對話才能自然延續。

sentences.en: Sometimes. It helps me learn new words.
sentences.zh: 有時候。這能幫我學習新單字。
sentences.tips: 聊興趣時，多問 And you? 或 What about you? 讓對方也有機會分享，對話才能自然延續。

sentences.en: That's a good idea. I also like photography.
sentences.zh: 那是個好主意。我也喜歡攝影。
sentences.tips: 聊興趣時，多問 And you? 或 What about you? 讓對方也有機會分享，對話才能自然延續。

sentences.en: Oh, what do you like to take pictures of?
sentences.tips: 聊興趣時，多問 And you? 或 What about you? 讓對方也有機會分享，對話才能自然延續。

sentences.en: Mostly flowers and nature. I find them beautiful.
sentences.zh: 主要是花和自然風景。我覺得它們很美。
sentences.tips: 「I find + 名詞 + 形容詞」比直接說 It is... 更有個人色彩，如 I find hiking very refreshing（我覺得健行很提神）。

sentences.zh: 我最喜歡的興趣是園藝。
sentences.tips: 表達喜好可用 I enjoy、I love、I like，後面接動名詞（-ing）或名詞，三者語意相近，enjoy 語氣最強烈。

sentences.en: I enjoy listening to classical music.
sentences.tips: 表達喜好可用 I enjoy、I love、I like，後面接動名詞（-ing）或名詞，三者語意相近，enjoy 語氣最強烈。

sentences.en: I like to watch movies on weekends.
sentences.tips: 表達喜好可用 I enjoy、I love、I like，後面接動名詞（-ing）或名詞，三者語意相近，enjoy 語氣最強烈。

sentences.en: Cooking is a fun activity for me.
sentences.zh: 烹飪對我來說是個有趣的活動。
sentences.tips: 聊興趣時，多問 And you? 或 What about you? 讓對方也有機會分享，對話才能自然延續。
「I find + 名詞 + 形容詞」比直接說 It is... 更有個人色彩，如 I find hiking very refreshing（我覺得健行很提神）。

sentences.en: Do you have any special hobbies?
sentences.zh: 你有什麼特別的嗜好嗎？
sentences.tips: 聊興趣時，多問 And you? 或 What about you? 讓對方也有機會分享，對話才能自然延續。

sentences.en: How did you get interested in that?
sentences.zh: 你是怎麼對那個產生興趣的？
sentences.tips: 詢問對方從何時開始某嗜好，說 How did you get into...? 或 When did you start...?，語氣自然有親和力。

vocabulary.example_zh: 我最喜歡的興趣是種花種菜。

vocabulary.example_en: I spend my Saturday mornings gardening.
vocabulary.example_zh: 我週六早上都在做園藝。

vocabulary.example_en: I'm learning photography from a friend.
vocabulary.example_zh: 我正在跟一位朋友學習攝影。

vocabulary.example_en: Taking a hot bath is very relaxing.
What do you do in your free time?

grammar_highlights.title: 談興趣常用句型：I like... / I enjoy...
grammar_highlights.description: I like... 和 I enjoy... 都可以用來說「我喜歡……」，後面可以加動名詞或名詞。
grammar_highlights.example_en: I enjoy listening to music in the evening.

grammar_highlights.title: 用 Do you...? 開啟話題
grammar_highlights.description: 想了解別人的興趣，可以用 Do you like...? 或 What do you like to do...? 來開啟對話。
grammar_highlights.example_en: Do you like watching TV shows?

grammar_highlights.title: 用 I find... 表達感受
grammar_highlights.description: I find + 名詞 + 形容詞 是一種表達你對某事感受的方式，比直接說 It is... 更個人化。

multiple_choice.question: 下列哪一句英文的意思是「嗨，你平常有空的時候喜歡做什麼？」？

options.en: Hi, what do you like to do in your free time?
options.zh: 嗨，你平常有空的時候喜歡做什麼？

options.en: I love gardening. It's very relaxing for me.
options.zh: 我喜歡園藝。這讓我非常放鬆。

options.en: That's nice. I enjoy reading and taking a walk in the park.
options.zh: 那很好。我喜歡看書和在公園散步。

options.en: Do you read books in English?

multiple_choice.answer: Hi, what do you like to do in your free time?
